item.title: [Engage] Issues with Abandoned Cart, Revenue Overview Dashboard and Automation Performance Dashboard [postmortem]
item.description:
# **Incident report**
## **Summary**
On September 1, an issue with an underlying service used by Voyado caused parts of the platform to stop working as expected.
The issue affected Abandoned Cart, the Revenue Overview Dashboard, new Analytics reports, and the Automation Overview Dashboard for all tenants using these features.
We identified the cause and implemented a fix that restored the affected functionality.
## **Customer impact**
During the incident, customers using the affected features experienced errors or were unable to access the expected information.
The following features were affected:
* Abandoned Cart * Revenue Overview Dashboard * New Analytics reports * Automation Overview Dashboard
No customer data was lost, modified, or exposed as a result of the incident.

item.title: Engage - email sending issues [resolved]
item.description:
The issue affecting email sending has been resolved. During the monitoring period, we have seen no indications of the issue recurring.
The disruption affected some email sendouts for a subset of customers between approximately 19:30 on Thursday and 17:30 on Friday. For affected sendouts, some emails were sent successfully, while a percentage were not sent due to the issue.
The delivery information shown in Engage is correct. Emails with an unknown delivery status were not delivered and will not be resent automatically.
We will conduct a post-mortem to further investigate the incident and determine the underlying root cause.
We apologize for the inconvenience caused.

item.title: [Engage] - Shopify App Service Disruption [resolved]
item.description:
The Shopify App has been operating normally, and the service has remained stable.
Additional information has been shared directly with the customers affected by the incident.

During the incident, affected customers may have experienced slower than normal response times, request timeouts, and intermittent error messages when using Engage.
The impact was limited to parts of the platform, and no customer data was lost.

item.title: Engage - issues with registration forms redirection not working [postmortem]
item.description:
### **Summary**
On 2 June 2026, we identified an issue where short links used in SMS campaigns did not redirect users to the intended destination. Instead, recipients were redirected to the login screen. The issue was resolved the same day.
### **Customer impact**
The issue affected customers using short links in SMS campaigns, including links to registration forms and mobile swipes. The impact period was approximately 15:40–18:17 CEST.
### **Root cause**
A code change introduced in the release on 2 June changed how short link redirects were handled. As a result, some SMS short links redirected to the login screen instead of the intended page.

item.title: [Engage] Issues with displaying Design Studio messages [postmortem]
item.description:
### Summary
On Friday, May 22, between approximately 11:15 and 12:45 CEST, users experienced issues when opening the Design Studio in Engage to list send-out messages.
Message sending was not impacted. Scheduled send-outs, automation send-outs, and message delivery to recipients continued to work as expected.
The issue was resolved after deploying a hotfix to the affected frontend services.

Customers using Design Studio in Engage were affected, the classic email editor was not impacted. During the incident, affected users could experience problems with:
* Viewing existing send-outs * Working with send-outs * Opening the Design Studio

item.title: Voyado Engage- Performance degradation affecting a subset of customers [postmortem]
item.description:
**Summary** Between April 7 and April 9, 2026, parts of the Voyado platform experienced degraded performance related to one of our database clusters. The issue caused slower response times and intermittent errors in affected parts of the platform, including our APIs and some connected background processing. We took immediate action to reduce the load, mitigate customer impact, and restore stability. Customers that were most affected by the database load were promptly moved to other database clusters, which resolved the issue for those customers.

item.title: [Engage] Incorrect timestamp format in Delta Share exports [postmortem]
item.description:

item.title: Engage - Vipps integration issues [postmortem]
item.description:
## Summary

item.title: App unavailable [postmortem]
item.description:
A recent network configuration update unintentionally interrupted communication between the Elevate App backend and a subset of Elevate clusters.
Because DNS records were still being served from cache, the change didn’t take effect right away. Once those cached entries expired, the loss of connectivity surfaced.
This timing gap made it harder to connect the incident to the earlier change, which extended our troubleshooting and recovery time.

item.title: [Elevate] Increased response times on various storefront API endpoints [postmortem]
item.description:
A release of Elevate introduced a bug in the calculation of promotion statistics, which caused CPU exhaustion leading to performance degradation of some Storefront endpoints.
When noticed, the release was aborted and rollback was made to the previous version.
The endpoints primarily affected were the landing-page and the product-page.
Not all customers were affected.

## **Root Cause**
The issue was caused by a configuration error that prevented necessary data from loading correctly.
## **Mitigation**
We identified the root cause and applied a fix by adjusting the storage setup. Full functionality was restored by 12:14 CET on the same day.

item.title: Engage - issue with one server affecting a subset of customers [postmortem]
item.description:
## Summary
On December 30th, a performance issue on one of our servers led to delayed API response times for a subset of customers. The issue was quickly identified and mitigated within approximately one hour.
## Customer Impact
The delays affected API responses for customers hosted on one specific server. All other parts of the platform remained fully functional.
## Root Cause
The issue was triggered by a large import job that attempted to process a high volume of transactions in a single run. This created a significant number of internal locks in our database, leading to degraded performance.
## Remediation & Prevention
Once the problematic job was identified, it was stopped, and a work-around was made to prevent further issues.

item.title: Engage - Problems submitting registration forms [postmortem]
item.description:
## **Summary**
On 2025-11-12, an issue was introduced in a morning update that caused registration forms to fail silently on submission for multiple customers. The forms appeared to work but did not process user input.
## **Customer Impact**
End-users were unable to submit registration forms or update communication preferences. No error messages were shown, which impacted onboarding and preference management flows.
## **Root Cause**
A bug in the released code affected how registration forms handled certain preference fields, causing submissions to fail without visible errors.
## **Mitigation**
A fix was identified and deployed to resolve the issue.

item.title: Voyado Engage - Delay in Event Processing [postmortem]
item.description:
## Summary
On November 7th, an unusually high number of internal events were generated due to a planned feature rollout. This caused delays in processing certain automations.
## Customer Impact
Automations triggered by customer interactions or audience targeting were delayed by up to 12 hours. All affected automations were eventually executed. Other parts of the platform operated as normal.
## Root Cause and Mitigation
When the new Marketing Groups feature was enabled for all customers, a large volume of events \(hundreds of millions\) was generated in a short time. The system processing these events could not keep up, which resulted in delays for other events in the same internal queue.

item.title: [Elevate] Search-page returning sporadic errors [postmortem]
item.description:
**Description**
During an A/B test of personalization functionality, an update introduced data that was not compatible with older system versions. This caused search-page errors for some shoppers when their requests were routed between nodes running different versions.
The A/B test was disabled promptly, preventing new incompatible data from being written. This action significantly reduced the error rate. Errors continued to occur for a limited number of shoppers who had already been affected, until all older nodes were fully upgraded.
* The majority of customers running the test experienced no impact.
* Most customers faced none or a few errors.
All systems were upgraded to the new version, eliminating the incompatibility and restoring full stability.

item.title: [Engage] - Inacurate Data In Revenue Overview Dashboard [postmortem]
item.description:
## Summary
A background system component failed to start due to outdated software. This caused some data to stop updating for a short period.
## Customer Impact
For a limited time, some customers saw outdated or missing data in the Revenue Overview Dashboard.
## Root Cause and Mitigation
The issue was caused by an outdated software dependency. The system was updated to the latest version, and we’ve added improved monitoring to detect similar issues earlier in the future.

item.title: [Engage] Delayed sendout status updates [postmortem]
item.description:
### Summary
Between October 7th and October 8th, users could experience delays in the display of message send-out status updates in the Engage interface. While the messages were sent as expected, the visual feedback in the interface did not reflect their actual status.
### Customer Impact
During the incident, message send-out status and related statistics were delayed in Engage. No messages were lost or failed to send—this was a display issue only.
### Root Cause
The delay was caused by an unusually large batch of events from our data processing pipeline that overwhelmed an internal message handler. item.title: [Engage] v3 Orders Currently Unavailable [postmortem]
item.description:
# **Summary**
On October 1st, 2025, the Order V3 API was unavailable between 12:00 and 14:30 CEST. The issue was caused by a faulty update intended to handle previously failed orders and led to serialization errors that made the API unresponsive. The problem was identified and a fix was deployed to restore normal operations.

A few customers were affected during the incident. Customers using the Order V3 API were unable to place or manage orders through this version of the API during the downtime. Other versions and platform features remained unaffected.

item.title: [Engage] Email Sendout Disruption [postmortem]
item.description:
## Summary
On September 30th, Engage experienced a temporary disruption in email send-outs due to an error in newly deployed code. The issue was quickly identified, and a hotfix was deployed. While no messages were lost, some email messages were delayed as the system worked through a backlog.
## Customer Impact
Majority of customers were potentially affected. Most experienced delays in automation emails. In a few cases, delays were up to 8 hours, but the majority of impacted messages were delivered within 3–4 hours. No SMS or priority messages were affected.
